notes: Product pair: SO-SFP-1000Base-BX20D-34 (TX/RX 1310/1490 nm; footnotes 1) and SO-SFP-1000Base-BX20D-43 (TX/RX 1490/1310 nm; footnotes 2). Transmit wavelength 1270–1350 nm (1) and 1460–1520 nm (2); receiver wavelength 1450–1530 nm (1) and 1260–1360 nm (2). Industrial option (-I): operating -40°C to +85°C. Storage -40°C to +85°C. Power budget 0–14 dB. Transmitter output power and receiver min/overload are average power (3). Receiver min input -22.0 dBm and overload -3.0 dBm at 1.25 Gbps, BER ≤ 1×10⁻¹², PRBS 2⁷-1, back-to-back (4). DDM per SFF-8472.
suggestions: Consider list types for temp_min_c/temp_max_c when C-temp and I-temp variants are both specified; map stated power budget (0–14 dB) to a dedicated field if distinct from channel_insertion_loss_db.
